feedback.worked_solution:
If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the curl of $F$ is the vector field given by

$$
curl\,F=∇\times F=|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ P & Q & R\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{curl}\,F & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ {z}^{2} & 2xy & x{y}^{2}\end{aligned}| \\  & =[\frac{∂}{∂y}(x{y}^{2})-\frac{∂}{∂z}(2xy)]i-[\frac{∂}{∂x}(x{y}^{2})-\frac{∂}{∂z}({z}^{2})]j+[\frac{∂}{∂x}(2xy)-\frac{∂}{∂y}({z}^{2})]k \\  & =(2xy-0)\,i-({y}^{2}-2z)\,j+(2y-0)\,k \\  & =2xy\,i-({y}^{2}-2z)\,j+2y\,k \\  & =⟨2xy,\,2z-{y}^{2},\,2y⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
